title: batten mediated-call policy input
description: The document a `scope = "mediated_call"` Rego module reads as `input`. Companion to policy-input.schema.json, which describes the TREE surface: the two share no keys, and a module type checked against the wrong one is CLOUD-845's defect deliberately introduced. The key set is asserted against `Fact::ALL` filtered to `Surface::Hook` by crates/batten/tests/policy_input_schema.rs. Checked in rather than generated; CLOUD-879 replaces it with a derivation.

call.description: The envelope the harness handed the boundary — what is being attempted, never a fact resolved about it.

facts.description: The `Surface::Hook` fact set, keyed by each fact's stable lowercase token (`Fact::as_str`). `additionalProperties: false` is the load-bearing line, exactly as on the tree surface: it is what makes `input.facts.receipt` a build-time error rather than an unconstrained `Any` that is undefined forever.

bypass.description: Fact::Bypass — the BATTEN_HOOK_BYPASS hatch (CLOUD-610). The one fact whose shape is certain enough to constrain.

receipts.description: Fact::Receipts — check -> verdict token, or null for could-not-look.

keys.description: Fact::Keys — the tracker-key evidence, or null for could-not-look.

waived.description: Fact::Waived — the rules a live waiver suppresses, with each claimed expiry.

agent-sourced.description: Fact::AgentSourced — what a command the AGENT ran said (CLOUD-776), or null.

prospective.description: Fact::Prospective — the SHAPE of what a write would land (CLOUD-758): look, bytes, lines. Never the content, which is where rule 4 is decided rather than promised.
